fix(beadrs-857f897d): emit audit events for structured-data mutations

set_data and remove_data committed semantic mutations with no events row,
so the live event sequence never advanced for structured-data changes —
the same P3 gap (plan 6.2.1 / ADR-003) fixed for issue creation in
beadrs-23fea176, dependencies in beadrs-633ff22e, and external references
in beadrs-4ba1412e.

Both mutations now append one event inside their own transaction via a
shared append_data_event helper: the event commits or rolls back with the
row it describes. The event's issue subject is the issue holding the
data, and the detail records namespace and schema_ref — never the
document body, which is schema-governed but unbounded. For remove, the
prior row's schema_ref is captured before the delete so the event records
which governance the removed document was under.

The inserts are gated on rows semantically changed: the set is
upsert-shaped (INSERT OR REPLACE reports one row changed even for an
identical rewrite), so the prior row decides — a new pair, a changed
value, or a changed schema_ref appends, an identical re-set does not; a
remove that deletes nothing appends nothing. Actor defaults to "system",
matching the created, dependency, and external-ref events.

Tests: unit tests cover event shape, body redaction, per-mutation
sequence advance, and the no-op cases (identical re-set, changed-value
re-set, changed-schema_ref re-set, missing-namespace remove); a CLI test
drives data set/remove through `bead changes --latest` and asserts the
cursor advances exactly once per real mutation and not at all for no-ops.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1 && git status --short | head

## Summary

**Fix (commit `0b5d502`)** — `set_data` and `remove_data` in `src/service/data.rs` now append audit events inside their own transactions via a shared `append_data_event` helper, closing the same plan-6.2.1-P3 gap fixed earlier for issue creation, dependencies, and external refs:

- **`data_set`** — appended when a set stores a new pair or changes the schema_ref or value. The set is upsert-shaped (`INSERT OR REPLACE` reports one row changed even for an identical rewrite), so the prior row is read first and decides: an identical re-set appends nothing.
- **`data_removed`** — appended only when the delete removes a row; the prior row's `schema_ref` is captured before the delete so the event records which governance the removed document was under (the remove command takes no schema_ref of its own).
- **Detail records `namespace` and `schema_ref` only** — the document body is schema-governed but unbounded, so it never enters the event log. Actor defaults to `"system"`, matching the other mutation events.

**Acceptance verified:**

- Detail carries namespace + schema_ref, not the body — asserted both on parsed detail and raw string
- `bead changes --latest` advances exactly once per real mutation and not at all for no-ops — driven through the real CLI in the new integration test
